description: Karnataka government to unveil a draft policy on Responsible AI by month-end, emphasizing ethical and secure AI governance.
body_lead: The draft of a policy on ‘Responsible AI’ is ready and the Karnataka government is set to release it by the end of the month, announced Shreevyas H.M., project director for the Artificial Intelligence (AI) Cell under the Centre for e-Governance (CeG). He was speaking at Karnataka AI Mantana, a dialogues series on AI-powered governance held by the State government. “A lot of thought has gone into the responsible AI policy by all the industry leaders and leaders from the government of Karnataka,” Mr. Shreevyas said.
